Understudy `BookRepository` is strict and received an unexpected call to `save()`.

The call was:
    save(Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Tests\Fixture\Book#1 {title: 'Dune'})

Nothing configured for `save` accepted it:
    save(*Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Tests\Fixture\Book#2 {title: 'Herbert'}*)

Configure it first: when(fn () => $double->save(...))->returns(...)
